title: Wanderers
body:
flash the lights
fluttered see
you’re not real please
talk to me

go there, share it
they don’t know
what to miss and
where to go

hands apart but
would you take mine
right to left
somewhere, sometime

title: Doing
body:
kill the grass
build taller, taller
choking nature
thinking smaller

don’t just lie there
see it coming
we will die there
bodies summing

don’t look past
don’t think too far
first ones first
leave footprint-scar

we were made here
didn’t like it?
own agenda,
refuse to fight it

ending; ended
sorry soil
